'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Hayes Hunter LS Fear, Piety, And Passion''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Hayes Hunter]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Fear, Piety, And Passion]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
